reason: The plugin is primarily a host-only DeepSeek Harness extension that exposes one simple utility tool (`greet`) for model calls, as documented in the repository description and README and supported by the DSH bundle configuration in package metadata and plugin file layout.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于在主机端为模型提供 `greet(name)` 工具并返回问候文本，目前未提供独立界面。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a host-side `greet(name)` tool for the model to call and return a greeting message.

capabilities: Registers a model-invokable `greet(name: string)` tool in a DeepSeek Harness plugin layer.
Returns a simple greeting string based on the provided name input.
Delivers the functionality as a host-side plugin module without any declared UI surface.
